## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met
- [ ] TDD followed (a failing test preceded the implementation)
- [ ] UX reference followed (frontend stories only — link it)
- [ ] Coverage gate held
- [ ] Lint + type checks clean
- [ ] Migration verified up **and** down (if schema changed)
- [ ] OpenAPI + generated types updated (if the API contract changed)
- [ ] Logs/metrics/traces emitted for new code paths
- [ ] Ownership test added (if a user-scoped resource was touched)
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated (if a decision was made)
